hypothesis: Ten catalogue neural architectures not yet screened (items 16 SAINT, 18 AutoInt, 19 DeepFM/xDeepFM, 20 NODE, 21 GRANDE, 22 TabNet, 23 ExcelFormer, 24 AMFormer, 25 T2G-Former, 26 Trompt) may carry inductive biases (row/column attention, factorized polynomial interactions, soft decision trees, sparsemax feature gating, semi-permeable/locality attention, prompt gating) whose fold-0 predictions decorrelate enough from the champion portfolio to pass the frozen admission rule.
why_distinct_from_prior_negatives: None of these 11 architectures has ever been run on this dataset; the 8 previously-screened neural archs (fttransformer/dcnv2/dcnv2full/factlog/plrmlp/tabresnet/moe/interactionnet) are different code paths in src/phase20/neural_arch.py. The frozen rule is unchanged: PROMISING iff port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr < 0.995 vs route reference (equal-logit blend with portfolio on fold-0).

decision_rule.port_delta: AUC(equal-logit blend(candidate, route_ref)) - AUC(route_ref) on primary fold-0
decision_rule.route_ref: sol_route_aux10_primary_final (champion-v7 proxy; v7 OOF not archived)
decision_rule.descriptive_only: standalone fold-0 AUC and logit Pearson are descriptive, never the decision rule

view: route (22-feature champion TabPFN representation, standardized on FIT-train only)
fold: primary fold-0 F2 screen (FIT = folds 1-4, inner 10% stratified ES split, seed 1)

env.arch_module: src/phase20/neural_arch.py (batch-2 additions smoke-tested fwd+bwd before freeze)

saint.recipe: SAINT (Gupta et al. 2020): interleaved column attention (per row over feature tokens) and row attention (per feature over in-batch rows, chunk-bounded at 1024) + FFN, mean-pool head

autoint.recipe: AutoInt (Song et al. 2019): multi-head self-attention over feature tokens with residual linear layers, flatten head

deepfm.recipe: DeepFM (Guo et al. 2017): linear + 2nd-order FM on value-scaled feature embeddings (e_j = x_j*w_j) + deep MLP

xdeepfm.recipe: xDeepFM (Lian et al. 2018): CIN compressed-interaction network (2 layers of vector-wise field-pair outer products with linear compression) + deep MLP + linear

node.recipe: NODE (Popovidchik et al. 2020): ensemble of differentiable soft oblivious trees (depth 6 x 8 trees) with path-probability gating, sigmoid leaves, linear skip

grande.recipe: GRANDE (Arik et al. 2024, distilled): K=8 random-subnetwork ensemble with fixed seeded feature masks (keep=0.5), learnable gates over subnetwork logits

tabnet.recipe: TabNet (Arik & Pfister 2019, compact adaptation): 5 steps of sparsemax attentive masking over hidden units with direction-aware arrow and D-matrix prior (relaxation 1.5), step logits summed; masks gate the hidden state (hidden-space variant)

excelformer.recipe: ExcelFormer (Yan et al. 2024, distilled): semi-permeable attention - softmax weights gated by sigmoid(alpha * logits) membrane, renormalized, + FFN over feature tokens

amformer.recipe: AMFormer (Zhao et al. 2024, distilled): attention with multi-head locality - each head's keys/values restricted to its contiguous feature slice, all queries attend, per-head outputs concatenated + FFN

t2gformer.recipe: T2G-Former (Zhao et al. 2023, distilled): tokens-to-gates transformer - self-attention over feature tokens, per-expert attention pooling with learnable queries gates G=4 MLP experts on raw features, gated sum

trompt.recipe: Trompt (Wu et al. 2023, distilled): P=6 parallel learnable prompts each content-attending over feature tokens with per-prompt MLP heads, averaged logit
